files.text: All right, space cadets, let's keep this quiz comet moving.
First up: how many questions are we launching into orbit?
Pick the question count, because apparently infinity was too many.
Grab your phone and choose the topics you want to bravely overestimate yourself in.
Pick your favorite categories. The quiz machine is judging your taste, politely.
Preferences received. The question blender is now making science noises.
I'm assembling the round now. Please enjoy this brief moment of false confidence.
Questions are loading. Somewhere, a spreadsheet just got very nervous.
Next question incoming. Eyes up, phones ready, dignity optional.
Here comes the next one. Try to look like you meant to know this.
Attention back to the screen. The quiz gremlin has selected another question.
Final question. This is where legends are made, and also where guesses wear tiny capes.
Answers are open. Tap your choice before your confidence changes its mind.
Choose wisely, or at least choose with theatrical commitment.
Lock in an answer on your phone. The universe accepts both knowledge and panic.
Everyone answered. Look at that, a tiny miracle with Wi-Fi.
All answers are in. No more hiding behind strategic hesitation.
Time is getting dramatic. If you're still thinking, think faster.
A few seconds left. This is your brain's final boarding call.
Last seconds. Pick something and pretend it was a strategy.
Hurry up. Even the timer is starting to sweat.
Answers locked. Regret may now begin forming in a neat little line.
And the correct answer is... please act surprised if needed.
Let's reveal the answer and see whose confidence was accidentally correct.
Nobody got it. The question wins this round and is being very smug about it.
Not a single correct answer. Somewhere, trivia is cackling into a tiny microphone.
Everybody got it right. Suspiciously competent, all of you.
Only one player got that right. One hero, surrounded by confident fiction.
Scores are updating. Please keep all victory dances inside the vehicle.
Points are being counted by highly trained imaginary interns.
Scores are changing behind the curtain. The curtain is feeling powerful.
We have a new leader. The leaderboard just rearranged its furniture.
First place has changed hands. Politely, but with consequences.
Somebody just rocketed up the rankings. Please secure your loose expectations.
Onward to the next question. Hydrate your brain if possible.
Next question is warming up. It has been stretching backstage.
At one point, only one player got the answer right. Mysterious. Impressive. Slightly annoying.
One question completely wiped the room. A clean sweep, but rude.
Someone put together a streak tonight. I'm not naming names, but their ego knows.
This finish is close enough to make the scoreboard breathe into a paper bag.
This round had twists, turns, and at least one answer that looked legally questionable.
Final results are coming up. Please prepare your gracious winner face, just in case.
Time for the final ranking. May the scoreboard be merciful and well-lit.
That's the game. You brought knowledge, guesses, and a surprising amount of confidence.
Cosmic Trivia is complete. Please return all borrowed brain cells to the front desk.
From here on, scores are hidden. Suspense has entered the chat.
The scoreboard is going undercover. You'll see the truth at the end.
A new player joined. The chaos budget has been increased.
The final question is armed and probably wearing sunglasses.
The final question is done. Now we let suspense do its weird little dance.
A player blipped out for a moment. Classic space internet behavior.
They're back. The signal survived its side quest.
Still waiting on a few taps. No rush, except for the very real rush.
Someone is still choosing. Maybe it's wisdom. Maybe it's snacks.
The signal is squeezing through an asteroid belt. Very normal technology.
Someone has a streak going. I won't say who, but the scoreboard is whispering.
Game paused. Everybody freeze in your most intelligent pose.
And we're back. Please resume pretending this was all under control.
The network is wobbling. Give it a second to remember its job.
Signal recovered. Technology has decided to participate again.
